start.speaker: narrator
start.text: You wake slowly. Not all at once -- in pieces. The tightness in your chest loosens. Just a little. But enough.

start_2.speaker: narrator
start_2.text: Morning light filters through the leaves above. The sanctuary garden stretches around you, familiar now.

start_3.speaker: oracle
start_3.text: {name}. You came back. I wondered if you would.

start_4.speaker: oracle
start_4.text: The cards have been restless this morning. They sense something shifting in you.

ask_vision.speaker: oracle
ask_vision.text: They see... a path that splits. Multiple roads, each leading somewhere you cannot yet imagine.

ask_rest.speaker: oracle
ask_rest.text: Then we will sit with the silence today. Sometimes the cards speak loudest when we are still.

ask_fool.speaker: oracle
ask_fool.text: The Fool walks forward without knowing what lies ahead. Scared. Hopeful. Both at once. Like you.
